from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.text import MSO_AUTO_SIZE, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pathlib import Path

base=Path('/home/user/workspace')
file=base/'out_b/Product_Launch_Final.pptx'
prs=Presentation(file)

def named(slide, name):
    return next(s for s in slide.shapes if s.name == name)
def text_of(slide, name, text):
    sh=named(slide,name)
    tf=sh.text_frame
    if tf.paragraphs and tf.paragraphs[0].runs:
        tf.paragraphs[0].runs[0].text=text
        # Remove any remaining runs and paras, if any.
        for p in list(tf.paragraphs)[1:]:
            p._p.getparent().remove(p._p)
        for r in list(tf.paragraphs[0].runs)[1:]:
            r._r.getparent().remove(r._r)
    else:
        tf.text=text
    return sh

# Cover: exact requested title and the solid sampled swatch color (#0D47A1).
cover=prs.slides[0]
text_of(cover,'SlideTitle','Project Helios v2.4 Launch')
text_of(cover,'BannerLabel','HELIOS • V2.4 PRODUCT LAUNCH')
banner=named(cover,'CoverBanner')
banner.fill.solid()
banner.fill.fore_color.rgb=RGBColor(13,71,161)

# Product overview: replace both drafting placeholders with fitted product views.
overview=prs.slides[2]
for name,img in [('ProductImagePlaceholderA','prod_front.png'),('ProductImagePlaceholderB','prod_side.png')]:
    old=named(overview,name)
    left,top,width,height=old.left,old.top,old.width,old.height
    old._element.getparent().remove(old._element)
    image=Image=None
    from PIL import Image as PILImage
    with PILImage.open(base/'in_b'/img) as im:
        iw,ih=im.size
    scale=min(width/iw,height/ih)
    w,h=int(iw*scale),int(ih*scale)
    pic=overview.shapes.add_picture(str(base/'in_b'/img),left+(width-w)//2,top+(height-h)//2,width=w,height=h)
    pic.name='Product view - '+('front' if 'front' in img else 'side')

# Launch parameters: apply all memo corrections and highlight the full Max row.
params=prs.slides[1]
table=next(s.table for s in params.shapes if s.has_table)
updates={(2,2):'5300',(2,4):'$1,299',(3,2):'6100',(3,3):'1.62'}
for (r,c),value in updates.items():
    table.cell(r,c).text=value
for c in range(len(table.columns)):
    cell=table.cell(3,c)
    cell.fill.solid()
    cell.fill.fore_color.rgb=RGBColor(220,233,248)
    # Ensure the highlighted row remains crisp and readable.
    for p in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
        for run in p.runs:
            run.font.color.rgb=RGBColor(32,54,76)

# Final slide: replace placeholder with three well-spaced, numbered launch points.
final=prs.slides[3]
body=named(final,'SummaryBody')
body.left=Inches(1.0); body.top=Inches(1.78); body.width=Inches(11.2); body.height=Inches(4.28)
tf=body.text_frame
tf.clear(); tf.word_wrap=True
tf.margin_left=Inches(0.08); tf.margin_right=Inches(0.08)
tf.margin_top=Inches(0.06); tf.margin_bottom=Inches(0.04)
tf.vertical_anchor=MSO_ANCHOR.TOP
tf.auto_size=MSO_AUTO_SIZE.TEXT_TO_FIT_SHAPE
points=[
'Helios Max leads the lineup with a 16-inch OLED display, 32 GB memory, and a 6100 mAh battery.',
'Launch inventory is staged across three fulfillment hubs, with priority allocation reserved for enterprise pilots.',
'Regional certification remains on the critical path, so initial sell-through targets should be treated as gated rather than committed.'
]
for i,content in enumerate(points):
    p=tf.paragraphs[0] if i==0 else tf.add_paragraph()
    p.space_after=Pt(17)
    p.line_spacing=1.13
    p.left_indent=Inches(0.02)
    p.font.name='Aptos'
    p.font.size=Pt(18)
    p.font.color.rgb=RGBColor(34,54,75)
    num=p.add_run(); num.text=f'{i+1}.  '
    num.font.name='Aptos'; num.font.size=Pt(18); num.font.bold=True; num.font.color.rgb=RGBColor(13,71,161)
    run=p.add_run(); run.text=content
    run.font.name='Aptos'; run.font.size=Pt(18); run.font.color.rgb=RGBColor(34,54,75)

# Add the required speaker note verbatim.
final.notes_slide.notes_text_frame.text='The pre-order mix is 42% Pro and 31% Max; do not publish a shipment date before the regional safety review is complete.'

# Order: cover, product overview, launch parameters, launch readout.
sld_ids=prs.slides._sldIdLst
ids=list(sld_ids)
sld_ids.remove(ids[1])
sld_ids.insert(1,ids[2])

out=base/'out_b'/'Product_Launch_Final_working.pptx'
prs.save(out)
out.replace(file)
print('saved',file)
